# AI Agent Rules

Before modifying anything:

Read:

docs/governance/00-CONSTITUTION.md

docs/governance/01-ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md

docs/governance/02-ARCHITECTURE_PRINCIPLES.md

docs/governance/03-RESTORATION_PROTOCOL.md

Rules:

- Never move directories without migration plan.
- Never remove existing features.
- Never commit automatically.
- Build before and after every change.
- Keep backward compatibility.
- Prefer modular architecture.
- Document every architectural decision.
- Stop immediately if build fails.
